text: Overall epistemic certainty of the OP's own assertions about their view, scored as an integer 0-10 from modality markers, using only the OP's "argument" field (current text, including marked edits; no reconstruction of pre-edit version). 0 = nearly all claims explicitly modest/uncertain/hedged ("I think", "maybe", "might", "I could be wrong", "not sure"); 5 = roughly even mix of hedged and unhedged claims; 10 = nearly all claims high-modality/categorical ("obviously", "definitely", "must", "always", "never", "undeniably") with no hedging. Aggregated over the whole argument by the balance of hedged vs high-certainty markers on claims central to the OP's position (an operational choice). Excludes quotations or reported opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them, moderator/bot notices, and any view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Returns null if the argument is missing, malformed, or has no assessable OP assertions after exclusions.
